scope: turning (right turns, left turns and U-turns, at intersections and elsewhere)

vocabulary.definition: The person driving the vehicle that is turning or about to turn.
The area on each side of the vehicle, usually to the back left and back right, that the driver cannot see in the mirrors.
The portion of a roadway that connects sidewalks on opposite sides into a continuous path, or that has signs, lines or other markings for pedestrian crossing; it may be unmarked.
A single white line painted across the road at an intersection showing where vehicles must stop.
A special lane for vehicles turning left, marked on the pavement at an intersection.
A centre lane of a road used by left-turning vehicles from both directions to wait for a chance to turn.
A flashing green light, or a left-pointing green arrow together with a green light, shown while oncoming traffic still faces a red light.
An intersection with separate traffic lights for left-turning traffic and for traffic going straight or turning right.
A turn made to reverse the direction of travel by turning into the opposite lane in one forward movement.
A lane reserved for cyclists, typically marked by a solid white line.
A police, fire, ambulance or special public-utility vehicle identified by flashing red or blue lights, a siren or bell, or alternating flashes of white light from its headlamp high beams.
A large commercial vehicle such as a tractor-trailer, truck or bus.
A circular intersection where traffic travels counter-clockwise around a central island and entering traffic yields to circulating traffic.

rules.title: Check around before turning
rules.when: about to turn a corner
rules.action: check the mirrors and over the shoulder to make sure the way is clear and there is enough space to complete the turn safely
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn a corner, the DRIVER MUST check the mirrors and over the shoulder to make sure the way is clear and there is enough space to complete the turn safely.

rules.title: Signal well before the turn
rules.when: about to turn
rules.action: signal well before the turn
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn, the DRIVER MUST signal well before the turn.
rules.note: Stated in several places; penalty taken from the table of offences entry 'Failing to signal'.

rules.title: Move into the proper lane
rules.when: preparing to turn AND the way is clear
rules.action: move into the far right lane for a right turn or the far left lane in the direction of travel for a left turn
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to turn AND the way is clear, the DRIVER MUST move into the far right lane for a right turn or the far left lane in the direction of travel for a left turn.
rules.note: The road test section adds that this should be done as soon as the way is clear.

rules.title: Look side to side and check blind spots
rules.when: about to turn a corner
rules.action: look from side to side and check the BLIND SPOTs to make sure the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn a corner, the DRIVER MUST look from side to side and check the BLIND SPOTs to make sure the way is clear.

rules.title: Slow down before the turn
rules.when: approaching a turn
rules.action: slow down before entering the turn, going slower the sharper the turn
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a turn, the DRIVER MUST slow down before entering the turn, going slower the sharper the turn.

vague_terms.explanation: no speed given for any turn sharpness

rules.note: 'Slow down' is a command; 'the sharper the turn, the slower you should go' is softer advice folded into the same rule.

rules.title: Finish braking before steering
rules.when: making a turn
rules.action: finish braking before turning the steering wheel
rules.statement: WHEN making a turn, the DRIVER MUST finish braking before turning the steering wheel.
rules.note: Reason given: to keep full control of the vehicle.

rules.title: Avoid braking and steering together
rules.when: making a turn
rules.action: brake and steer at the same time
rules.statement: WHEN making a turn, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT brake and steer at the same time.
rules.note: Reason given: drivers often lose control and skid when doing more than one thing at a time.

rules.title: Hand-over-hand steering for sharp turns
rules.when: making a sharp turn
rules.action: use hand-over-hand steering, turning the wheel with one hand and crossing the other hand over it to grip the other side and continue turning
rules.statement: WHEN making a sharp turn, the DRIVER MUST use hand-over-hand steering, turning the wheel with one hand and crossing the other hand over it to grip the other side and continue turning.

rules.title: No one-finger or palm steering
rules.when: turning the steering wheel during a turn
rules.action: turn the steering wheel with one finger or the flat palm of the hand
rules.statement: WHEN turning the steering wheel during a turn, the DRIVER MUST NOT turn the steering wheel with one finger or the flat palm of the hand.

rules.title: Straighten the wheel and speed up gradually
rules.when: completing a turn
rules.action: relax the grip and let the steering wheel slip or feed it through the hands back to the straight-ahead position, and gradually increase speed
rules.statement: WHEN completing a turn, the DRIVER MUST relax the grip and let the steering wheel slip or feed it through the hands back to the straight-ahead position, and gradually increase speed.

rules.title: Yield when turning at an intersection
rules.when: turning left or right at any intersection
rules.action: yield the right-of-way
rules.statement: WHEN turning left or right at any intersection, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way.
rules.penalty: Three demerit points (failing to yield the right-of-way).
rules.note: Penalty taken from the table of offences.

rules.title: Signalling gives no right-of-way
rules.when: turning after signalling
rules.action: make sure the way is clear before moving
rules.statement: WHEN turning after signalling, the DRIVER MUST make sure the way is clear before moving.
rules.note: The handbook states that signalling does not give the right-of-way.

rules.title: Blocked intersection: turning exception
rules.when: approaching an intersection on a main road AND the intersection is blocked with traffic
rules.action: stop before entering the intersection and wait until the traffic ahead moves on
rules.unless: the DRIVER is turning left or right
rules.statement: WHEN approaching an intersection on a main road AND the intersection is blocked with traffic, the DRIVER MUST stop before entering the intersection and wait until the traffic ahead moves on, UNLESS the DRIVER is turning left or right.

rules.title: Abandon the turn for an emergency vehicle
rules.when: in an intersection AND preparing to make a turn AND an EMERGENCY VEHICLE is approaching
rules.action: abandon the turn, clear the intersection by proceeding straight when safe to do so, then pull to the right and stop
rules.statement: WHEN in an intersection AND preparing to make a turn AND an EMERGENCY VEHICLE is approaching, the DRIVER SHOULD abandon the turn, clear the intersection by proceeding straight when safe to do so, then pull to the right and stop.
rules.note: Reason given: the emergency vehicle may pass on the side the driver intended to turn towards.

rules.title: White lane arrow
rules.when: in a lane with a white arrow painted on it
rules.action: move in the direction of the arrow
rules.statement: WHEN in a lane with a white arrow painted on it, the DRIVER MAY ONLY move in the direction of the arrow.
rules.note: The marking image is not given.

rules.title: Right turn close to the right side
rules.when: making a right turn
rules.action: begin and end the turn close to the right side of the road
rules.unless: signs or pavement markings direct otherwise
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn, the DRIVER MUST begin and end the turn close to the right side of the road, UNLESS signs or pavement markings direct otherwise.
rules.note: Penalty inferred from the table of offences entry 'Improper right turn'.

rules.title: Unmarked right lane: keep far right
rules.when: preparing to make a right turn AND the right-hand lane is not marked
rules.action: keep as far to the right of the road as possible
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to make a right turn AND the right-hand lane is not marked, the DRIVER MUST keep as far to the right of the road as possible.

vague_terms.term: as far to the right of the road as possible

rules.title: Look before starting a right turn
rules.when: about to start a right turn
rules.action: look ahead, left, right and left again
rules.statement: WHEN about to start a right turn, the DRIVER MUST look ahead, left, right and left again.

rules.title: Check the right blind spot for cyclists
rules.when: turning right
rules.action: check the mirrors and the BLIND SPOT to the right, including for cyclists approaching from behind in a BIKE LANE, on a sidewalk or on a trail, so as not to cut off a cyclist
rules.statement: WHEN turning right, the DRIVER MUST check the mirrors and the BLIND SPOT to the right, including for cyclists approaching from behind in a BIKE LANE, on a sidewalk or on a trail, so as not to cut off a cyclist.
rules.note: 9.10 says to check the right rear blind spot if no smaller vehicles or pedestrians have been seen; 6.35 gives it as a command; 7.20 words it as 'should'. The stronger wording is recorded.

rules.title: Let cyclists and mopeds go first
rules.when: making a right turn AND a cyclist, limited-speed motorcycle or moped rider is going through the intersection
rules.action: let the cyclist, limited-speed motorcycle or moped rider go through the intersection before turning
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn AND a cyclist, limited-speed motorcycle or moped rider is going through the intersection, the DRIVER MUST let the cyclist, limited-speed motorcycle or moped rider go through the intersection before turning.

rules.title: Complete into the right-hand lane
rules.when: making a right turn AND it is safe
rules.action: complete the turn into the right-hand lane of the road being entered
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn AND it is safe, the DRIVER MUST complete the turn into the right-hand lane of the road being entered.

rules.title: Wait for pedestrians when turning right
rules.when: turning right at an intersection AND pedestrians are in or approaching the DRIVER's path
rules.action: wait for the pedestrians to cross
rules.statement: WHEN turning right at an intersection AND pedestrians are in or approaching the DRIVER's path, the DRIVER MUST wait for the pedestrians to cross.
rules.note: Refers to Diagram 2-20, which is not given.

rules.title: Right turn on a red light
rules.when: facing a red light
rules.action: turn right after first coming to a complete stop and waiting until the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN facing a red light, the DRIVER MAY ONLY turn right after first coming to a complete stop and waiting until the way is clear, UNLESS a sign prohibits the turn.
rules.note: Where a sign prohibits it, the right turn on red is not allowed at all. Stated on two pages.

rules.title: Signal and yield on a red-light right turn
rules.when: turning right on a red light
rules.action: signal the turn and yield to pedestrians and others using the road
rules.statement: WHEN turning right on a red light, the DRIVER MUST signal the turn and yield to pedestrians and others using the road.

rules.title: Entering a bike lane to turn right
rules.when: needing to enter or cross a BIKE LANE to turn right at a corner or driveway
rules.action: take extra care and enter the BIKE LANE only after ensuring it can be done safely, then make the turn
rules.statement: WHEN needing to enter or cross a BIKE LANE to turn right at a corner or driveway, the DRIVER MUST take extra care and enter the BIKE LANE only after ensuring it can be done safely, then make the turn.
rules.note: Refers to Diagram 2-12, which is not given.

rules.title: Wheels straight while waiting to turn right
rules.when: waiting to turn right AND there is a risk of being pushed into pedestrians crossing the intersection
rules.action: keep the front wheels straight
rules.statement: WHEN waiting to turn right AND there is a risk of being pushed into pedestrians crossing the intersection, the DRIVER MUST keep the front wheels straight.

vague_terms.explanation: no criterion for when the risk exists

rules.note: From the road test section.

rules.title: Follow the curb at large intersections
rules.when: waiting to turn right at a large intersection with curved sidewalks
rules.action: angle the vehicle to follow the curb so that no other vehicle can fit between the vehicle and the curb
rules.statement: WHEN waiting to turn right at a large intersection with curved sidewalks, the DRIVER MUST angle the vehicle to follow the curb so that no other vehicle can fit between the vehicle and the curb.
rules.note: From the road test section.

rules.title: Right lane blocked after turning right
rules.when: turning right onto a road where the right lane is blocked with parked vehicles or cannot be used for other reasons
rules.action: move directly to the next available lane
rules.statement: WHEN turning right onto a road where the right lane is blocked with parked vehicles or cannot be used for other reasons, the DRIVER MUST move directly to the next available lane.
rules.note: From the road test section.

rules.title: Left turn in the far left lane
rules.when: making a left turn
rules.action: begin and end the turn in the far left lane in the DRIVER's direction
rules.unless: signs or pavement markings direct otherwise
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn, the DRIVER MUST begin and end the turn in the far left lane in the DRIVER's direction, UNLESS signs or pavement markings direct otherwise.
rules.note: Penalty inferred from the table of offences entry 'Improper left turn'.

rules.title: Look before a left turn
rules.when: about to make a left turn
rules.action: look ahead, behind, left, right and left again, check the BLIND SPOTs, and make the turn only when the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN about to make a left turn, the DRIVER MUST look ahead, behind, left, right and left again, check the BLIND SPOTs, and make the turn only when the way is clear.

rules.title: Wait for oncoming traffic and pedestrians
rules.when: turning left at an intersection
rules.action: wait for approaching traffic to pass or turn and for pedestrians in or approaching the DRIVER's path to cross
rules.statement: WHEN turning left at an intersection, the DRIVER MUST wait for approaching traffic to pass or turn and for pedestrians in or approaching the DRIVER's path to cross.
rules.note: Refers to Diagram 2-20, which is not given.

rules.title: Wait for oncoming bicycles
rules.when: turning left at an intersection AND bicycles are oncoming
rules.action: stop and wait for the oncoming bicycles to pass before turning
rules.statement: WHEN turning left at an intersection AND bicycles are oncoming, the DRIVER MUST stop and wait for the oncoming bicycles to pass before turning.

rules.title: Keep wheels straight while waiting to turn left
rules.when: stopped at an intersection waiting to turn left for approaching traffic to clear
rules.action: turn the steering wheel to the left until the turn can be completed
rules.statement: WHEN stopped at an intersection waiting to turn left for approaching traffic to clear, the DRIVER MUST NOT turn the steering wheel to the left until the turn can be completed.
rules.note: Reason given: with the wheels turned left, the vehicle could be pushed into oncoming traffic. The road test section says to keep the front wheels straight.

rules.title: Opposing left turns pass left of each other
rules.when: two vehicles coming from opposite directions meet in an intersection waiting to turn left
rules.action: turn to the left of the other vehicle after yielding the right-of-way to pedestrians and oncoming traffic
rules.statement: WHEN two vehicles coming from opposite directions meet in an intersection waiting to turn left, the DRIVER SHOULD turn to the left of the other vehicle after yielding the right-of-way to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Do not turn beside a small vehicle
rules.when: making a left turn behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: pull up beside it to turn at the same time, but stay behind and turn when the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the DRIVER MUST NOT pull up beside it to turn at the same time, but stay behind and turn when the way is clear.

rules.title: Wait before passing a small vehicle after the turn
rules.when: having turned left behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: wait for the smaller vehicle to move right before passing it
rules.statement: WHEN having turned left behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the DRIVER MUST wait for the smaller vehicle to move right before passing it.

rules.title: Left turn from centre-line lane to right of centre line
rules.when: turning left from the lane closest to the centre line onto a road with a centre line
rules.action: turn to the lane just right of the centre line following a smooth arc, then move into the right curb lane when possible
rules.statement: WHEN turning left from the lane closest to the centre line onto a road with a centre line, the DRIVER MUST turn to the lane just right of the centre line following a smooth arc, then move into the right curb lane when possible.
rules.note: The road types this applies to are shown only in diagrams that are not given; the conditions are taken from the lane names in the text.

rules.title: Left turn from centre-line lane to left curb lane
rules.when: turning left from the lane closest to the centre line onto a road with a left curb lane
rules.action: turn into the left curb lane
rules.statement: WHEN turning left from the lane closest to the centre line onto a road with a left curb lane, the DRIVER MUST turn into the left curb lane.
rules.note: The road types are shown only in a missing diagram; the conditions are taken from the lane names in the text.

rules.title: Left turn from left curb lane to right of centre line
rules.when: turning left from the left curb lane onto a road with a centre line
rules.action: turn to the lane just right of the centre line, then move into the right curb lane when possible
rules.statement: WHEN turning left from the left curb lane onto a road with a centre line, the DRIVER MUST turn to the lane just right of the centre line, then move into the right curb lane when possible.
rules.note: The road types are shown only in a missing diagram; the conditions are taken from the lane names in the text.

rules.title: Left turn from left curb lane to left curb lane
rules.when: turning left from the left curb lane onto a road with a left curb lane
rules.action: turn into the left curb lane
rules.statement: WHEN turning left from the left curb lane onto a road with a left curb lane, the DRIVER MUST turn into the left curb lane.
rules.note: The road types are shown only in a missing diagram; the conditions are taken from the lane names in the text.

rules.title: Move to the curb lane after turning left
rules.when: having turned left onto a multi-lane road
rules.action: return to normal traffic speed and move into the curb lane when it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN having turned left onto a multi-lane road, the DRIVER MUST return to normal traffic speed and move into the curb lane when it is safe to do so.

vague_terms.term: when it is safe to do so

rules.note: From the road test section.

rules.title: Left turn on a red light
rules.when: facing a red light AND turning from a one-way road onto a one-way road
rules.action: turn left after coming to a complete stop and making sure the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN facing a red light AND turning from a one-way road onto a one-way road, the DRIVER MAY ONLY turn left after coming to a complete stop and making sure the way is clear.
rules.note: Stated on two pages.

rules.title: Yield on a red-light left turn
rules.when: turning left on a red light from a one-way road onto a one-way road
rules.action: yield to pedestrians and traffic
rules.statement: WHEN turning left on a red light from a one-way road onto a one-way road, the DRIVER MUST yield to pedestrians and traffic.

rules.title: Turn from the marked left-turn lane
rules.when: turning left at an intersection where LEFT-TURN LANEs are marked on the pavement
rules.action: make the turn from the marked lane and keep this lane position when turning onto the other road
rules.statement: WHEN turning left at an intersection where LEFT-TURN LANEs are marked on the pavement, the DRIVER MUST make the turn from the marked lane and keep this lane position when turning onto the other road.
rules.note: Refers to Diagram 2-35, which is not given.

rules.title: Entering a two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: using a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE to turn left
rules.action: signal, move into the centre lane shortly before the turn and slow down
rules.statement: WHEN using a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE to turn left, the DRIVER MUST signal, move into the centre lane shortly before the turn and slow down.
rules.note: Refers to Diagram 2-36, which is not given.

rules.title: Position in the two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: in a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE waiting to turn left
rules.action: carefully move forward to a spot opposite the road or driveway to be turned into
rules.statement: WHEN in a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE waiting to turn left, the DRIVER MUST carefully move forward to a spot opposite the road or driveway to be turned into.

rules.title: Turn from the two-way lane only when sure
rules.when: in a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE ready to turn left
rules.action: make the turn only when sure the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN in a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE ready to turn left, the DRIVER MUST make the turn only when sure the way is clear.
rules.note: The handbook warns that vehicles waiting in the lane from the opposite direction may block the view of oncoming traffic.

rules.title: No passing in a two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: on a road with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing
rules.statement: WHEN on a road with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing.
rules.note: Worded as 'are not to be used for passing'.

rules.title: Turning on a green light
rules.when: facing a green light
rules.action: turn left or right after yielding to vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection
rules.statement: WHEN facing a green light, the DRIVER MAY turn left or right after yielding to vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection.

rules.title: Yield to crossing pedestrians on green
rules.when: turning left or right on a green light
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to pedestrians crossing the intersection
rules.statement: WHEN turning left or right on a green light, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to pedestrians crossing the intersection.

rules.title: Advance green light
rules.when: facing an ADVANCE GREEN LIGHT
rules.action: turn left, go straight ahead or turn right from the proper lane
rules.statement: WHEN facing an ADVANCE GREEN LIGHT, the DRIVER MAY turn left, go straight ahead or turn right from the proper lane.

rules.title: Left-turn green arrow
rules.when: in the LEFT-TURN LANE AND facing a left-turn green arrow
rules.action: turn left from the LEFT-TURN LANE, watching that vehicles from the opposite direction may also be turning left
rules.statement: WHEN in the LEFT-TURN LANE AND facing a left-turn green arrow, the DRIVER MAY turn left from the LEFT-TURN LANE, watching that vehicles from the opposite direction may also be turning left.
rules.note: Stated for simultaneous left turns (arrow with a red light) and for fully protected left turns.

rules.title: Yellow arrow: do not start the left turn
rules.when: a yellow arrow appears after the left-turn green arrow
rules.action: not start the left turn and stop
rules.statement: WHEN a yellow arrow appears after the left-turn green arrow, the DRIVER MUST not start the left turn and stop, UNLESS the DRIVER cannot stop safely.

rules.title: Yellow arrow: complete with caution if unable to stop
rules.when: a yellow arrow appears after the left-turn green arrow AND the DRIVER cannot stop safely
rules.action: complete the turn with caution
rules.statement: WHEN a yellow arrow appears after the left-turn green arrow AND the DRIVER cannot stop safely, the DRIVER MUST complete the turn with caution.

rules.title: Left turn on green after the arrow
rules.when: the light is green after a left-turn arrow phase at a simultaneous left-turn intersection
rules.action: turn left when the way is clear of traffic and pedestrians
rules.statement: WHEN the light is green after a left-turn arrow phase at a simultaneous left-turn intersection, the DRIVER MAY ONLY turn left when the way is clear of traffic and pedestrians.

rules.title: Light turns red during the left turn
rules.when: in the intersection turning left AND the light turns red
rules.action: complete the turn when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN in the intersection turning left AND the light turns red, the DRIVER MUST complete the turn when it is safe.

rules.title: Fully protected: no late left turn
rules.when: at a FULLY PROTECTED LEFT-TURN INTERSECTION AND the green light has appeared for traffic going straight ahead or turning right
rules.action: begin turning left
rules.statement: WHEN at a FULLY PROTECTED LEFT-TURN INTERSECTION AND the green light has appeared for traffic going straight ahead or turning right, the DRIVER MUST NOT begin turning left.
rules.note: Worded 'you may not begin turning left'.

rules.title: Fully protected: yellow while turning
rules.when: at a FULLY PROTECTED LEFT-TURN INTERSECTION AND in the intersection turning left AND the light turns yellow
rules.action: complete the turn with caution
rules.statement: WHEN at a FULLY PROTECTED LEFT-TURN INTERSECTION AND in the intersection turning left AND the light turns yellow, the DRIVER MUST complete the turn with caution.

rules.title: Watch for pedestrians during turns
rules.when: turning at an intersection with a signalled CROSSWALK, especially when turning left
rules.action: watch for pedestrians crossing
rules.statement: WHEN turning at an intersection with a signalled CROSSWALK, especially when turning left, the DRIVER MUST watch for pedestrians crossing.
rules.note: The handbook notes that many more pedestrians are hit by left-turning than right-turning cars.

rules.title: Oncoming motorcycle with signal on
rules.when: turning left in front of an oncoming motorcycle with its turn signal on
rules.action: be careful and make sure the motorcyclist is actually turning
rules.statement: WHEN turning left in front of an oncoming motorcycle with its turn signal on, the DRIVER MUST be careful and make sure the motorcyclist is actually turning.
rules.note: Reason given: many motorcycle turn signals do not shut off automatically.

rules.title: Large vehicle turning right
rules.when: a LARGE VEHICLE in front is making a right turn
rules.action: move up into the space that opens up in the right lane, but stay well back until the truck has completely cleared the lane
rules.statement: WHEN a LARGE VEHICLE in front is making a right turn, the DRIVER MUST NOT move up into the space that opens up in the right lane, but stay well back until the truck has completely cleared the lane.
rules.note: Reason given: the vehicle may swing wide left and the trailer can squeeze a car against the curb.

rules.title: Large vehicle turning left on a dual left-turn off-ramp
rules.when: a LARGE VEHICLE in front is making a left turn AND there are two left-turning lanes
rules.action: drive up into the left lane, but stay well back until the truck has cleared the left turn
rules.statement: WHEN a LARGE VEHICLE in front is making a left turn AND there are two left-turning lanes, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive up into the left lane, but stay well back until the truck has cleared the left turn.
rules.note: Given for expressway off-ramps with two left-turning lanes.

rules.title: Check for a no-U-turn sign
rules.when: about to make a U-TURN
rules.action: check that there is no sign saying not to make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN about to make a U-TURN, the DRIVER MUST check that there is no sign saying not to make a U-TURN.
rules.note: The table of offences lists 'Prohibited turns' at two demerit points, but does not link it explicitly to this rule.

rules.title: See well both ways for a U-turn
rules.when: making a U-TURN
rules.action: be able to see well in both directions
rules.statement: WHEN making a U-TURN, the DRIVER MUST be able to see well in both directions.

vague_terms.explanation: see TURN-UT-04 for the 150 m minimum

rules.title: Illegal U-turn locations
rules.when: on a curve in the road, OR on or near a railway crossing, OR on or near a hilltop, OR near a bridge or tunnel that blocks the view
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN on a curve in the road, OR on or near a railway crossing, OR on or near a hilltop, OR near a bridge or tunnel that blocks the view, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.
rules.note: Worded as illegal.

rules.title: 150 metres visibility for a U-turn
rules.when: considering a U-TURN
rules.action: make the U-TURN
rules.unless: the DRIVER can see at least 150 metres in both directions
rules.statement: WHEN considering a U-TURN, the DRIVER MUST NOT make the U-TURN, UNLESS the DRIVER can see at least 150 metres in both directions.

rules.title: Pull over right before a U-turn
rules.when: beginning a U-TURN
rules.action: signal for a right turn, check the mirror and over the shoulder, pull over to the right side of the road and stop
rules.statement: WHEN beginning a U-TURN, the DRIVER MUST signal for a right turn, check the mirror and over the shoulder, pull over to the right side of the road and stop.

rules.title: Make the U-turn
rules.when: stopped at the right side of the road to make a U-TURN
rules.action: signal a left turn and, when traffic is clear in both directions, move forward and turn quickly and sharply into the opposite lane, checking for traffic while turning
rules.statement: WHEN stopped at the right side of the road to make a U-TURN, the DRIVER MUST signal a left turn and, when traffic is clear in both directions, move forward and turn quickly and sharply into the opposite lane, checking for traffic while turning.

rules.title: Roundabout: left lane to turn left
rules.when: approaching a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT intending to turn left
rules.action: use the left lane and not enter the ROUNDABOUT from the right lane
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT intending to turn left, the DRIVER MUST use the left lane and not enter the ROUNDABOUT from the right lane.
rules.note: The left lane may also be used to go straight. Refers to Diagrams 2-37 and 2-38, which are not given.

rules.title: Roundabout: right lane to turn right
rules.when: approaching a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT intending to turn right
rules.action: use the right lane
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT intending to turn right, the DRIVER MUST use the right lane.
rules.note: The right lane may also be used to go straight.

rules.title: Right turn with a trailer
rules.when: making a right turn
rules.action: check traffic, look in the right mirror, signal and slow down
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST check traffic, look in the right mirror, signal and slow down.

rules.title: Sharp right turn with a trailer
rules.when: making a sharp right turn
rules.action: move ahead until the vehicle's front wheels are well ahead of the curb before turning to the right
rules.statement: WHEN making a sharp right turn, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST move ahead until the vehicle's front wheels are well ahead of the curb before turning to the right.

rules.title: Left turn with a trailer
rules.when: making a left turn
rules.action: check traffic, signal, proceed slowly and swing wide by driving well into the intersection before turning
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST check traffic, signal, proceed slowly and swing wide by driving well into the intersection before turning.

rules.title: Traffic check before slowing for a turn
rules.when: approaching a turn
rules.action: look all around and use the rearview and side mirrors to check traffic behind before slowing down, and check the BLIND SPOT by looking over the shoulder if changing lanes
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a turn, the DRIVER MUST look all around and use the rearview and side mirrors to check traffic behind before slowing down, and check the BLIND SPOT by looking over the shoulder if changing lanes.
rules.note: From the Level Two road test section.

rules.title: Signal timing with side-road entrances
rules.when: approaching a turn
rules.action: turn on the signal before slowing down for the turn
rules.unless: vehicles are waiting to enter the road from side roads or driveways between the DRIVER and the intersection, in which case the DRIVER waits until past these entrances
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a turn, the DRIVER MUST turn on the signal before slowing down for the turn, UNLESS vehicles are waiting to enter the road from side roads or driveways between the DRIVER and the intersection, in which case the DRIVER waits until past these entrances.
rules.note: Reason given: so drivers will not think you are turning before the intersection.

rules.title: Steadily reduce speed
rules.when: approaching a turn
rules.action: steadily reduce speed
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a turn, the DRIVER MUST steadily reduce speed.

rules.title: Downshift allowed when slowing
rules.actor: DRIVER of a vehicle with manual transmission
rules.when: slowing down approaching a turn
rules.action: downshift into a lower gear
rules.statement: WHEN slowing down approaching a turn, the DRIVER of a vehicle with manual transmission MAY downshift into a lower gear.

rules.title: No coasting on the clutch
rules.actor: DRIVER of a vehicle with manual transmission
rules.when: slowing down approaching a turn
rules.action: coast with a foot on the clutch pedal
rules.statement: WHEN slowing down approaching a turn, the DRIVER of a vehicle with manual transmission MUST NOT coast with a foot on the clutch pedal.

rules.title: Following distance while slowing
rules.when: slowing down approaching a turn
rules.action: keep at least a two- to three-second distance behind the vehicle in front
rules.statement: WHEN slowing down approaching a turn, the DRIVER MUST keep at least a two- to three-second distance behind the vehicle in front.

rules.title: Complete stop without rolling
rules.when: unable to complete a turn without stopping because the way is not clear OR facing a stop sign OR facing a red traffic light
rules.action: come to a complete stop without letting the vehicle roll forward or backward
rules.statement: WHEN unable to complete a turn without stopping because the way is not clear OR facing a stop sign OR facing a red traffic light, the DRIVER MUST come to a complete stop without letting the vehicle roll forward or backward.
rules.note: When traffic allows, the driver moves forward to check the way is clear or to start the turn.

rules.title: Do not back up past the stop line
rules.when: having to stop for a turn after passing the STOP LINE
rules.action: back up
rules.statement: WHEN having to stop for a turn after passing the STOP LINE, the DRIVER MUST NOT back up.

rules.title: Space behind a stopped vehicle
rules.when: stopped behind another vehicle at an intersection waiting to turn
rules.action: leave enough space to pull out and pass without having to back up
rules.statement: WHEN stopped behind another vehicle at an intersection waiting to turn, the DRIVER MUST leave enough space to pull out and pass without having to back up.

rules.title: Where to stop before turning
rules.when: the first vehicle approaching an intersection with a red light or stop sign to turn
rules.action: stop behind the STOP LINE, or if there is none at the CROSSWALK, or if there is none at the edge of the sidewalk, or if there is none at the edge of the intersection
rules.statement: WHEN the first vehicle approaching an intersection with a red light or stop sign to turn, the DRIVER MUST stop behind the STOP LINE, or if there is none at the CROSSWALK, or if there is none at the edge of the sidewalk, or if there is none at the edge of the intersection.

rules.title: Traffic check before entering
rules.when: stopped waiting to turn OR about to enter the intersection to turn
rules.action: keep checking traffic all around and, just before entering, look left, ahead and right to check that the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN stopped waiting to turn OR about to enter the intersection to turn, the DRIVER MUST keep checking traffic all around and, just before entering, look left, ahead and right to check that the way is clear.
rules.note: Traffic is not properly checked if another road user with the right-of-way must take action to avoid the vehicle.

rules.title: Eye contact when right-of-way is in doubt
rules.when: turning AND there is doubt about the right-of-way
rules.action: try to make eye contact with nearby drivers or pedestrians
rules.statement: WHEN turning AND there is doubt about the right-of-way, the DRIVER SHOULD try to make eye contact with nearby drivers or pedestrians.

rules.title: Blind spot when overtaking is possible
rules.when: about to start a turn AND another vehicle could overtake the DRIVER during the turn
rules.action: check the BLIND SPOT before starting to turn
rules.statement: WHEN about to start a turn AND another vehicle could overtake the DRIVER during the turn, the DRIVER MUST check the BLIND SPOT before starting to turn.

rules.title: Both hands throughout the turn
rules.when: making a turn
rules.action: use both hands to turn the steering wheel throughout the turn
rules.unless: the DRIVER has a disability that prevents using both hands
rules.statement: WHEN making a turn, the DRIVER MUST use both hands to turn the steering wheel throughout the turn, UNLESS the DRIVER has a disability that prevents using both hands.

rules.title: No gear shifting during the turn
rules.actor: DRIVER of a vehicle with manual transmission
rules.when: making a turn
rules.action: shift gears during the turn
rules.unless: the shift is made immediately after the vehicle starts moving but before it is well into the turn, OR the intersection is wider than four lanes AND not shifting would slow down other traffic
rules.statement: WHEN making a turn, the DRIVER of a vehicle with manual transmission MUST NOT shift gears during the turn, UNLESS the shift is made immediately after the vehicle starts moving but before it is well into the turn, OR the intersection is wider than four lanes AND not shifting would slow down other traffic.

rules.title: Start the turn promptly
rules.when: it becomes safe to start a turn
rules.action: move ahead within four to five seconds
rules.statement: WHEN it becomes safe to start a turn, the DRIVER MUST move ahead within four to five seconds.

rules.title: Steady speed through the turn
rules.when: making a turn
rules.action: turn at a steady speed slow enough to keep full control without slowing down other traffic, increasing speed as the turn is completed
rules.statement: WHEN making a turn, the DRIVER MUST turn at a steady speed slow enough to keep full control without slowing down other traffic, increasing speed as the turn is completed.

vague_terms.term: slow enough to keep full control

rules.title: Not too wide or too short
rules.when: making a turn
rules.action: turn into the corresponding lane on the intersecting road without going over any lane markings or curbs
rules.statement: WHEN making a turn, the DRIVER MUST turn into the corresponding lane on the intersecting road without going over any lane markings or curbs.

rules.title: End in the corresponding lane
rules.when: completing a turn
rules.action: end the turn in the lane that corresponds to the lane turned from
rules.statement: WHEN completing a turn, the DRIVER MUST end the turn in the lane that corresponds to the lane turned from.
rules.note: Exceptions for left turns onto multi-lane roads and blocked right lanes are in TURN-LT-13 and TURN-RT-13.

rules.title: Mirror check after the turn
rules.when: returning to normal traffic speed after a turn
rules.action: check the mirrors to become aware of the traffic situation on the new road
rules.statement: WHEN returning to normal traffic speed after a turn, the DRIVER MUST check the mirrors to become aware of the traffic situation on the new road.

rules.title: Accelerate smoothly after the turn
rules.when: returning to normal traffic speed after a turn
rules.action: accelerate smoothly to blend with the surrounding traffic, moderately in light traffic and more quickly if needed in heavier traffic
rules.statement: WHEN returning to normal traffic speed after a turn, the DRIVER MUST accelerate smoothly to blend with the surrounding traffic, moderately in light traffic and more quickly if needed in heavier traffic.
rules.note: In a manual vehicle, shift gears as speed increases.
